subject: RE: Gen8 KRDMA fleet — rollback required
unique_body:
All,

We rolled back the KRDMA driver update on the Gen8 fleet after Sev2 latency spikes were observed across 3 clusters at 08:30 UTC. The rollback is complete. Root cause investigation is in progress — early signals point to a NUMA affinity regression in the new driver version.

No customer impact reported. IcM #78-4421 opened.

— On-call

subject: NOVA weekly sync — decisions and next steps
unique_body:
Team,

Summary of today's NOVA weekly sync:

1. We agreed to slip the Gen9 broad fleet target date to 2026-07-15. The dependency on the BIOS validation team was cited as the primary blocker. Priya will now own the Gen9 bringup coordination going forward.

2. The Sev2 on KRDMA (IcM #78-4421) was escalated to Sev1 by the CAB at 16:45 today given the fleet-wide scope.

3. Action item: Jordan will finalize the risk mitigation runbook for the Gen7 phase-out by 2026-06-25.

Recording and notes in the team channel.

— PM

subject: NOVA risk update — Gen9 partner dependency blocking P0
unique_body:
Team,

I want to flag a new risk to the Gen9 delivery timeline. The dependency on the partner silicon validation team is now blocking our P0 milestone. We had expected their sign-off by June 18, but they have pushed to no earlier than July 10 due to resource constraints on their side.

This puts our 2026-07-15 broad fleet target at risk. I am scheduling a triparty call with silicon validation, BIOS AP, and NOVA leads for 2026-06-24 to align on a path forward.

I will plan to escalate to the VP level if we cannot resolve by 2026-06-25.

— PM
